preservationRules: Complete canonical source payload remains persisted in historical_import_rows after commit.
Only existing active users are linked; missing historical actors remain source IDs and email snapshots.
Original approval decisions are stored as historical evidence; they are not replayed as new approvals.
Vendor name/type snapshots are retained even when vendorSourceId cannot be resolved.
Receipt bytes must match the original byte size, detected MIME and SHA-256 before commit.
Source/imported totals are compared in integer paise. Any variance requires reconciliation.

lifecycleRules.stage: Immutable source manifest only; no voucher, sequence or historical event writes.
lifecycleRules.validate: Check duplicate source identities/numbers, target conflicts, child references and private receipt integrity.
lifecycleRules.upload: Stage receipt bytes in private storage under deterministic batch/source identity.
lifecycleRules.commit: Owner-only atomic ledger write with idempotent commit and monotonic number sequence advancement.

exclusions: No Google Sheets/Drive extraction is performed.
A structural backup check is not proof of restore success.
